description: Production-ready reusable code library for AI agents, conversational bots, messaging adapters, security guardrails, and distributed async systems.

modules.name: WhatsApp Cloud API Adapter
modules.description: Parses Meta Cloud API inbound webhooks and renders outbound text, interactive buttons, list messages, and media.

modules.name: Telegram Bot API Adapter
modules.description: Parses Telegram Bot updates and sends outbound MarkdownV2 text, inline keyboards, reply keyboards, and media.

modules.name: Chatwoot Live-Agent Client
modules.description: Bi-directional integration with Chatwoot live support desk. Manages contact lookup, conversation creation, and message relaying.

modules.name: Base Channel Adapter Interface
modules.description: Abstract base class defining parse_inbound and render_and_send contract for all channel adapters.

modules.name: Unified Normalised Messaging Protocol (UNMP)
modules.description: Channel-agnostic data schemas for inbound messages, outbound responses, sender identities, and interactive payloads.

modules.name: Chatwoot Webhook Schemas
modules.description: Typed Pydantic models for parsing Chatwoot webhook payloads (message_created, conversation_status_changed).

modules.name: Webhook Security & Signature Verification
modules.description: Constant-time HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, timing-safe Telegram token validation, and atomic Redis replay prevention.

modules.name: FastAPI Webhook Gateway Router
modules.description: Sub-200ms ACK webhook endpoints for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Chatwoot with immediate queue offloading via ARQ.

modules.name: Conversation Engine & Distributed FSM
modules.description: Finite State Machine with Redis distributed mutex locking (via atomic Lua script release) to prevent button-mashing and race conditions.

modules.name: Human Handoff Manager
modules.description: Coordinates seamless handoff between automated bot conversation and human agents on Chatwoot.

modules.name: Interactive Flow Engine
modules.description: Step-by-step interactive workflow engine supporting custom validators, dynamic prompts, and transition branching.

modules.name: Message & Command Router
modules.description: Dispatches incoming messages to slash commands, interactive button callbacks, active flows, or AI assistants.

modules.name: Dual-Tier AI Security Guardrails
modules.description: Zero-trust AI safety layer: automated PII masking (credit cards, emails, SSN, phone numbers), prompt delimiter sandboxing, and dynamic canary token leakage defense.

modules.name: Multi-Provider LLM Gateway
modules.description: Unified LLM client supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, and Ollama with automated fallback, streaming, and tool execution.

modules.name: AI Token Cost Controller & Budgeting
modules.description: Per-user and tenant daily token consumption tracking using Redis sliding counters to prevent quota exhaustion and runaway costs.

modules.name: Conversation Sliding-Window Memory
modules.description: Redis-backed conversation memory preserving multi-turn chat history with sliding window size and configurable TTL.

modules.name: Lightweight Embedding RAG Knowledge Base
modules.description: Vector embedding retrieval with cosine similarity ranking and dynamic prompt augmentation for contextual Q&A.

modules.name: Sandboxed Tool & Function Calling
modules.description: Framework for registering Python functions as OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic compatible tools with automatic JSON schema generation.

modules.name: Atomic Redis Sliding-Window Rate Limiter
modules.description: High-performance sliding-window rate limiter powered by an atomic Redis Lua script to neutralize DoS and flooding attacks.

modules.name: Rolling SHA-256 Bot Loop Detector
modules.description: Detects and breaks infinite ping-pong loops between automated bots by computing rolling message hashes across a sliding time window.

modules.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
modules.description: Admin and client authentication context, JWT validation, and route dependency guards.

modules.name: Dynamic Redis Feature Flags & Kill Switch
modules.description: Runtime configuration switches, percentage rollouts, and instant emergency kill switches without restarting services.

modules.name: Secure Media Downloader & SSRF Protection
modules.description: Downloads and validates media attachments with anti-SSRF IP blocking (blocks private/loopback/cloud metadata IP ranges).

modules.name: Multi-Locale Template Engine
modules.description: Channel-agnostic i18n template registry supporting parameter substitution and fallback locales.

modules.name: Cross-Channel Identity Resolution
modules.description: Unifies user records across WhatsApp phone numbers, Telegram chat IDs, and Web CRM profiles into a single persistent user record.

modules.name: Payment Gateway & Webhook Validator
modules.description: Stripe webhook signature validation and subscription tier provisioning in Redis.

modules.name: ARQ Distributed Async Task Worker
modules.description: Async Redis queue (ARQ) background task processor for parsing messages, running FSM, executing AI pipelines, and dispatching outbound messages.
